display.purpose: The single oversized italic statement per section. DM Serif Display italic, no other use of italic in the system.

headline.purpose: Secondary statements inside sections: case study titles, founder quotes.

title.purpose: Card and list-item titles, service names, testimonial author lines.

body.purpose: All running text. Consolas, never sans. Brand commitment.

label.purpose: ALL-CAPS metadata, eyebrows, category tags. Letter-spaced 0.2em.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and entrance reveals. Strong exponential ease-out, no overshoot.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Used for the scan-shimmer on the dark hero card only.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Text color crossfades, focus state shifts.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Default for button hover, link underline reveals.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Bento cell hover sweep, large card enter animations.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sharp violet button with ALL-CAPS Consolas label. Hover fills to ink-deep, no lift, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5B21B6; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1A0A2E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5B21B6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent button, ink-deep text. Hover swaps text to violet.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1A0A2E; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #5B21B6; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Signature section header. 32px violet rule + ALL-CAPS Consolas label. Used above every section's Display headline.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-eyebrow-rule { display: block; width: 32px; height: 1px; background: #5B21B6; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-eyebrow-text { font-family: Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #5B21B6; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Light Card
components.description: Flat paper-pure surface. 1px hairline border. Zero radius. No shadow.
components.html:
KLARHEIT

Brand Identity & Brand System

Marke, Tone of Voice und visuelles System aus einer Hand.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E6E6E6; border-radius: 0; padding: 32px; color: #1A0A2E; } .ds-card-label { display: block; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3A3A3A; opacity: 0.45; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.2; color: #1A0A2E; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: #3A3A3A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Ink-deep surface with paper text. Used for hero cells, featured case studies. Optional violet glow blob inside.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { position: relative; background: #1A0A2E; border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 40px; color: #FFFFFF; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-dark-glow { position: absolute; right: -5rem; top: -5rem; width: 22rem; height: 22rem; background: #5B21B6; opacity: 0.18; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(80px); pointer-events: none; } .ds-card-dark-label { position: relative; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30); } .ds-card-dark-title { position: relative; font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 3.25rem); line-height: 0.95; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 20px 0 0 0; }

components.name: Display Headline
components.description: The signature DM Serif italic statement. One per section.
components.css: .ds-display { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #1A0A2E; margin: 0; } .ds-display em { font-style: italic; color: #5B21B6; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Flat input. 1px hairline. Zero radius. Focus shifts border to violet.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3A3A3A; } .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E6E6E6; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #1A0A2E; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #5B21B6; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(58,58,58,0.4); }

narrative.overview: New Edge looks like a high-end editorial press that also happens to ship software. The typography behaves like a magazine masthead: DM Serif Display italic at oversized scale. The grid behaves like an engineer's drawing: zero border-radius, 1px hairlines, no decorative chrome. Every section is one printed page with one moment that surprises. Cards do not soften, they cut.
keyCharacteristics: Light parchment surface (#FCFCFC), pure white cards, deep ink (#1A0A2E) for editorial weight
DM Serif Display italic as the only display face; Consolas as the only body/label face
Zero border-radius everywhere — sharp corners are brand law
Hairline borders (1px) replace shadows for separation
One violet accent that earns its appearance; never a gradient, never glow as default
Asymmetric editorial grids over identical card decks
Motion is functional: reveal on enter, sweep on hover, scan-shimmer on dark hero

rules.name: The Single Cut Rule
rules.body: Violet Edge appears on a maximum of 15% of any screen. The rarity is what makes it land.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: #000 is prohibited. All deep surfaces use Ink Deep (#1A0A2E), which carries the violet hue at ~3% chroma.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Background gradients are prohibited as decoration. The single permitted gradient is the ThreeStepsCTA section's directional violet wash.

rules.name: The One-Italic Rule
rules.body: Display is always italic; nothing else is. Italic earns gravity because it is rare.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section announces itself with a Label-cased eyebrow preceded by a 32px violet hairline.

rules.name: The Monospace-for-Voice Rule
rules.body: Body copy is Consolas, not a sans-serif. This is a brand commitment, not an oversight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. No drop shadow on cards, no inner shadow on inputs, no glow on hover.

rules.name: The Glow Exemption
rules.body: The hero card and dark featured cases may carry one blurred violet blob behind their content. Reads as light leak, not elevation.

dos: Do treat each section as a magazine spread: one Display moment, one supporting passage, one CTA.
Do lead every section with the Section Eyebrow signature.
Do keep DM Serif Display italic large (clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) minimum).
Do use 1px Hairline borders for separation.
Do flatten everything; change background to differentiate, not shadow.
Do let Violet Edge appear once per fold. The single cut.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: kill scan shimmers, parallax, and bento hover sweeps.
Do write Body copy in Consolas. Always.
donts: Don't round corners. Zero radius is brand law.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use background gradients as decoration.
Don't apply box-shadow for ambient elevation.
Don't use pure #000 or pure #fff for text or major surfaces.
Don't stack identical cards in a deck-of-six grid.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
Don't write headings in non-italic display type.
Don't introduce a new font. DM Serif Display + Consolas is the entire family.
Don't decorate KI/AI references with neon, glow orbs, or 'Powered by AI' badges.
Don't use stock photos of laughing teams in front of laptops.
